description: A plant manager must authorize a weekend packaging run on a newly installed robotic palletizer and finalize the changeover, barcode verification, and reject-handling controls, with input from maintenance and quality.

shared_context.S1: The plant plans to package 900 finished cartons on Line 6 during the weekend shift.
shared_context.S2: Line 6's newly installed robotic palletizer is available for the run, and manual palletizing remains the fallback.
shared_context.S3: The weekend plan favors the robotic palletizer because it reduces labor and keeps the packaging area within its normal staffing level.
shared_context.S4: Before Maya authorizes the run, the standard pre-run meeting includes a maintenance review and a quality review of the operating controls.

PF1.text: Jonas's commissioning check found that the 900-carton order contains three carton sizes, so the robotic palletizer requires two programmed gripper changeovers and a total of exactly 90 minutes of pre-run setup; he has not entered this in the maintenance work order because the commissioning packet is still awaiting his supervisor's signature.

PF2.text: Priya confirmed in the customer's pilot-packaging instruction that all 900 cartons must receive a barcode scan and be palletized into exactly three family groups: 300 cartons of Family X, 280 cartons of Family Y, and 320 cartons of Family Z; she has not uploaded the instruction to the quality system because the customer service team is still linking the purchase-order revision.

acceptance_conditions: The robotic palletizer must be used for the run.
The plan must include exactly 90 minutes of pre-run setup.
All 900 cartons must receive barcode scanning.
The cartons must be assigned to the three exact customer family counts.
Manual handling must be available for rejected cartons.
The two gripper changeovers must be recorded as a maintenance commitment.
The customer family-count instruction must be cited as justification.

content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'gripper_changeover_setup' and c['target'] == 'Line 6' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The three carton sizes create two gripper changeovers and exactly 90 minutes of setup, changing the plan from an unspecified robotic startup to a 90-minute setup with a recorded changeover commitment.

The customer instruction changes verification to 100% scanning and changes the pallet plan to exactly 300 Family X, 280 Family Y, and 320 Family Z cartons, while requiring that instruction to be cited.
